program.name: Bell Back
program.subject: Back
program.blurb: Back with one kettlebell: rows, high pulls and swings, then a day of legs and presses.
program.about: Back work for a home with one kettlebell. One day is rows: dead-stop rows, kettlebell rows and high pulls. The next mixes rows with swings, which work the whole back of the body, and a floor pull. The third day is squats and presses. Abs finish every session; Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Bell rows / pulls & swings / legs & press
